heldout_guard: Only frozen search/dev task IDs are read before verified dev_summary/dev_selection/confirm_binding hashes; no confirm rows sent in observer payload.
limitations: Observation is a sequence of individually hash-bound reads, not an atomic cross-file snapshot.
Completed PNG bytes are not downloaded or reverified; their recorded hashes remain in returned operation receipts.
Current processes and historical failure artifacts are distinct facts; neither implies scientific success.
No new resource permission or launch authorization is inferred.
